messages.subject: Bootstrap Carousel Won't Show Images
parts:
I put the images into the www directory and I used the code below in ui.R. I see the broken image icon keeps sliding in from the right, but no images are displayed.

withTags(div(id = "functionsCarousel", class = "carousel slide", `data-ride` = "carousel",
    ol(class = "carousel-indicators",
      li(`data-target` = "#functionsCarousel", `data-slide-to` = "0", class = "active"),
      li(`data-target` = "#functionsCarousel", `data-slide-to` = "1"),
      li(`data-target` = "#functionsCarousel", `data-slide-to` = "2")
      ),
div(class = "carousel-inner", role = "listbox",
    div(class = "item active",
      img(src = "datsets.png")
    ),
    div(class = "item",
      img(src = "measurement.png")
    ),
    div(class = "item",
      img(src = "survival.png")
    )
)
))

What else has to be done for the carousel to find the images?

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Re: Bootstrap Carousel Won't Show Images
parts: Deleting the images from the directory and recreating them resolved the problem.
